mines.mine_notes: Development-stage open pit gold project, Alaska (one of the world's largest undeveloped gold deposits). Held by Donlin Gold LLC: NOVAGOLD 60% / Paulson 40% (since June 3, 2025; previously 50/50 with Barrick Mining). 2025: advanced BFS preparation, project director hired (Frank Arcese), community engagement, pipeline discussions. 2026 focus: commence bankable feasibility study; NOVAGOLD's pro-rata share of expenditures to increase. No production in FY2025. P&P reserves not restated in 10-K (fields null; refer to Donlin Gold technical report).

notes: 10-K used (fiscal year ended November 30, 2025). Development-stage company: no gold production, no operating earnings. Cash resources (cash, term deposits, marketable securities) ~$120M at Nov 30, 2025; net loss $94.7M ($0.25/share). Future development funding anticipated via corporate/project debt, equity, royalty/stream, government support. All amounts in USD.
